20165.long_desc: A compact and versatile 14.9 Inch (16:5) LCD Monitor ideal for a variety of applications including Active Marquee for Arcade Machines, DMD for Virtual Pinball Machines or Advertising Display.This monitor offers a 16:5 viewing ratio with VGA and HDMI inputs and supports 15khz/24khz/31khz, and high definition up to 1280 x 390. The features of the new monitor are; - VGA & HDMI input, for RGB input, please use the Arcooda RGB board - video input support: 15khz, 24khz, 31khz, and up to 1280 x 390 resolution at low monitor lag - extendable monitor adjustment board. Mount inside the monitor frame, or, use the extension to mount at the front of your arcade machine. - Audio output support: connect your HDMI input into the 14.9 Inch (16:5) LCD Monitor, then connect your 3.5mm audio jack out of the monitor into your audio system. - Clear Display: Enjoy a crisp visual experience with a resolution of 1280x390 pixels. - Compact Design: Its small size makes it perfect for space-saving setups or portable use. - Versatility: Multiple inputs including HDMI, VGA, and 9 pin Molex Whether you're looking for a secondary monitor for multitasking, a monitor for a small footprint, or a replacement screen, the 14.9-inch LCD monitor is a dependable choice.
